description: The file defines interfaces for error handling in firmware, including functions for warnings, fatal errors, and version information. It also contains macros for assertions related to firmware errors.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Reports a warning condition, indicating a minor issue like a sensor disconnection.

methods.name: firmwareError
methods.description: Reports a fatal error indicating the firmware cannot continue normal operation.

methods.name: getFirmwareError
methods.description: Retrieves the latest firmware error message.

methods.name: getRusEfiVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the RusEfi firmware.
